programs.summary: Global crypto-funded payment card programme operated by Topplex Marketing Ltd. Current first-party disclosures identify Third National as issuer and current product material describes Mastercard merchant acceptance; exact original launch date is not asserted.

Reloadable physical and virtual Visa Signature crypto card integrated with the Zypto app. Crypto is converted to fiat when the card is loaded; current Zypto legal disclosures identify Third National as issuer.

Argentina-local prepaid Mastercard integrated with Takenos for peso-denominated spending. Current Takenos terms identify Pomelo Fintech Services S.A.S. as issuer and describe crypto-to-peso conversion for card purchases; this programme is distinct from the international TakeCard.

relations.scope_note: NORACARD e-sign and card terms identify Third National as issuer. No exact relationship start date is inferred.

Current NORACARD public material describes spending at Mastercard merchants. Generic terms also contemplate Visa or Mastercard, so this relation is limited to the current evidenced product presentation.
Zypto card terms, GLBA disclosure and account-opening disclosures identify Third National as issuer. No exact operational start date is inferred.
Current Zypto product and help material identify the Premium product as Visa / Visa Signature.
Takenos SpicyCard terms explicitly identify Pomelo Fintech Services S.A.S. as issuer. The terms publication date is not treated as the issuer relationship start date.
Takenos current SpicyCard help and legal terms identify Mastercard as the network for the Argentina-local prepaid card.

events.title: Zypto suspends new Premium Card onboarding in three U.S. states
events.description: Zypto's restricted-jurisdictions disclosure states that new consumer cardholder onboarding and new corporate onboarding in Missouri, Mississippi and Tennessee would be suspended effective March 12, 2026, with existing cardholders given a transition window through April 27, 2026.
